integrity: All embedded files have per-entry SHA-256 and byte lengths; the code is a finite consistency check, not a formal or independent proof.
scientific_limitations: Uniform iid single-draw model only; asymptotic weak convergence without a rate. Previously established finite singleton joint enumeration and first-order exponential limiting laws are not claimed as new; some related full text was inaccessible.
title: A randomly centered Laplace fluctuation law at coupon collection
